facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Health Information Centre says its 2020 report was generated from the Civil Registration Authority's electronic system, which recorded 231,670 births and 31,051 deaths in 2020.

The Health Information Centre states that all Civil Registration Authority offices are fully automated and electronically linked to the central CRA, working through a single automated system on the same database; no date is given, so the document's published year is used.

The Health Information Centre states that all CRA offices are fully automated and linked: the foreword counts 12 branches, 133 issuing offices and 400 service offices on the single system, while the historical overview gives 12 branches and 380 service offices; no date is given, so the published year is used.

The report states that the Civil Registration Authority, of the Ministry of Interior, manages the collection of births and deaths data and issues the legal documents; no date is given, so the published year is used.
